From the rebellious verses of Sahir Ludhianvi to the wit and humour of Mirza Ghalib, Naseeruddin Shah takes the audience through an engaging celebration of Urdu poetry. He explores how poetry reflects hunger, poverty, injustice and human suffering, before bringing alive Ghalib's humour and the hilarious world of Imtiaz Ali Taj's Chacha Chhakkan.
